Overview: A thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is offered a chance to erase his past.
When the menace known as the Joker emerges, Batman must confront chaos and corruption in Gotham.
A young lion prince grows into his destiny and learns the importance of family and courage.
A jazz pianist and an aspiring actress fall in love while chasing their dreams in Los Angeles.
Mark Zuckerberg creates a social networking site that transforms communication and friendship worldwide.
